g3.sentence: It owns no baseline, promotes no candidate, and returns no verdict about a run.
It does not render, does not compare two readings, does not classify a difference into a band, and never produces a verdict.

It reaches no state, drives no browser, holds nothing still, paints nothing, compares nothing and performs no I/O of its own: a raw capture arrives as plain data, and anything else it needs arrives as an argument.

It applies no operator policy — an ignore is a site on the tree and never an absorbed change, a sensitivity is never read here, no verdict is spelled, and whether two readings that disagree are an instability is decided elsewhere.
It never infers cause from a pixel — causality runs code → meaning → pixels in one direction, so an author is looked up rather than reconstructed.

Nothing here observes: no verdict, no cause and no region is computed in this block — each arrives already attributed from adjudication inside the artifact report owns — and a promotion moves evidence a run already uploaded rather than painting any.

It owns neither the baseline store nor the record it re-serves from the same socket; those are retention's protocols, restated here over this deployment's own bindings so one address answers a run and a reviewer.

It owns no policy — not the normalization ruleset, not what an ignore means, not the stabilization recipe, not arrival, not which subjects a change could have moved — and it does not paint, does not compare, and holds no baseline.

It does not observe, does not decide when to re-read, does not choose or keep baselines, and does not aggregate for a person: it receives readings normalization already made comparable, and emits per-subject observations and per-rule ledgers, in plan order, owning neither the format nor its readings.
It never infers cause from a pixel — causality runs code → meaning → pixels in one direction, so an author is looked up rather than reconstructed.

It does not compare, does not store, and does not decide whether the image was needed: adjudication owns the pixel comparison, the mask, the regions and every verdict, and settling a subject against the prior reading's document digest happens before a document is handed here.
It does not choose what to observe, does not drive an application to a state, does not read a live tree, does not decide where a baseline lives and never promotes one.
